literature_notes: M6PR (CD-MPR, UniProt P20645) is a type I single-pass transmembrane protein. Its ectodomain spans residues 27–190 (extracellular), the TM helix spans 191–210, and the cytoplasmic tail spans 211–277. The sole ledger entry [L1] describes a C-terminal furin/T2A/GFP fusion appended to the full-length receptor. The C-terminus (residue 277, Met) is intracellular; this construct therefore places the tag on the cytoplasmic face, not the extracellular surface. No ledger line reports any tag insertion in the ectodomain, at the mature N-terminus (after signal-peptide cleavage at residue 26), or in any extracellular loop. Because the ledger contains no qualifying extracellular insertion, zero surface sites are proposed. The C-terminal GFP fusion is recorded in other_positions as an intracellular tag.

literature_other_positions.note: C-terminal furin/T2A/GFP fusion appended to full-length M6PR; residue 277 (Met) lies in the intracellular tail (topology 211–277), so the tag faces the cytoplasm, not the extracellular surface.
